topics.title: Write a Paragraph about Keeping in Touch with Family Abroad
guiding_questions: Who is the family member living abroad?
How do you keep in touch with him/her?
How often do you contact him/her?
Why is staying in touch important?
topics.sample_essay: My sister lives abroad in Canada. She moved there two years ago. We keep in touch every week. We use Skype and WhatsApp to talk. I can see her face and hear her voice. We also send photos and messages. Staying in touch is important. It makes us feel close and happy together always indeed.

topics.title: Write an Email to a Friend Living on Another Planet
guiding_questions: Who is your friend on another planet?
What do you want to tell him/her about Earth?
What do you miss about him/her?
What do you want to ask him/her?
topics.sample_essay: Hi Sam, I am writing to tell you about my life on Earth. I go to school every day. Life here is busy. We have amazing technology now. We use phones and computers to talk to people far away. We travel by fast cars, trains and planes. I miss you. Tell me about your planet.
